source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 32 (PDF 232-246), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 32 (Medicine, Agriculture and Industry) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define pharmacology. Why is it said that every drug may be a potential poison?
(Pharmacology ki tareef karein. Kyun kaha jata hai ke har drug mumkina zehar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pharmacology woh science hai jo batati hai ke drug kya karta hai aur kin safety margins (hifazati hudood) mein kaam karta hai. Har drug zehar ban sakta hai kyun ke dawa aur zehar ka farq sirf dose (miqdaar) ka hai.

book_ref.quote: Pharmacology is the science which deals with, what a drug does

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between minimum effective concentration (MEC) and minimum toxic concentration (MTC).
(Minimum effective concentration (MEC) aur minimum toxic concentration (MTC) mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: MEC therapeutic window ki nichli had aur MTC oopri had hai:

book_ref.quote: Minimum effective concentration (MEC) is the lowest dose of the drug

rows: Woh kam se kam dose jis se neeche drug asar nahi karta
Woh kam se kam dose jis par drug nuqsan ya zehar shuru karta hai
Therapeutic window ki nichli had
Therapeutic window ki oopri had
Is se neeche drug be-asar hai
Is se oopar drug khatarnak hai

blocks.prompt:
3 What is meant by duration of action of a drug?
(Drug ki duration of action se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Duration of action woh waqt hai jitni der drug ki concentration therapeutic window, yani MEC aur MTC ke darmiyan, rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Duration of action is the time duration in which the drug concentration remains within its therapeutic window.

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is the therapeutic window called the 'sweet spot' of medicine?
(Therapeutic window ko medicine ka 'sweet spot' kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke is range mein concentration na itni kam ke drug be-asar ho aur na itni ziyada ke khatarnak ho; drug nuqsan ke baghair kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the “sweet spot” of medicine

blocks.prompt:
5 Why is a drug with a narrow therapeutic window less safe than one with a wide window?
(Narrow therapeutic window wala drug wide window wale se kam mehfooz kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Narrow window mein effective dose toxic dose ke bohat qareeb hoti hai, thori tabdeeli bhi nuqsan de sakti hai; is liye blood level check hota hai. Wide window mein dono doses mein bara faasla hota hai, dose mein gunjaish hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A narrow therapeutic window means the drug is less safe

blocks.prompt:
6 Name four factors that may affect the therapeutic window of a drug.
(Char factors likhein jo drug ki therapeutic window par asar daal sakte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Aik saath kai dawaiyan, genetic factors, motapa (obesity), umar aur aam sehat. Yeh drug ke metabolism aur asar ko control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The simultaneous use of multiple medicines, genetic factors, obesity, age, or overall health

blocks.prompt:
7 Define therapeutic index and write its formula.
(Therapeutic index ki tareef karein aur us ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Therapeutic index (TI) drug ki safety ki miqdaari pemaish hai. Yeh toxic dose ko effective dose se compare karta hai: TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀ (figure mein ulta chhapa hai).

book_ref.quote: It compares the dose that causes a toxic effect to the dose that produces a desired therapeutic effect.

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between TD₅₀ and ED₅₀.
(TD₅₀ aur ED₅₀ mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono se therapeutic index nikala jata hai:

book_ref.quote: ED₅₀ (Effective Dose 50) is defined as the dose that works for 50% of the people who take it.

rows: Woh dose jo lene walon mein se 50% par zehreela asar kare
Woh dose jo lene walon mein se 50% par kaam kare
TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀ mein oopar (numerator)
TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀ mein neeche (denominator)

blocks.prompt:
9 A drug has ED₅₀ = 8 mg and TD₅₀ = 96 mg. Calculate its therapeutic index and comment on its safety.
(Aik drug ka ED₅₀ = 8 mg aur TD₅₀ = 96 mg hai. Is ka therapeutic index nikalein aur safety par raye dein.)
blocks.explanation: TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀ = 96/8 = 12. TI 12 ziyada hai, effective aur toxic dose mein bara faasla hai, is liye drug kaafi mehfooz hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, a drug with a TI of 10 is much safer than one with a TI of 2.

blocks.prompt:
10 A drug has a therapeutic index of 5 and TD₅₀ = 75 mg. Find its ED₅₀.
(Aik drug ka TI = 5 aur TD₅₀ = 75 mg hai. Is ka ED₅₀ maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀, is liye ED₅₀ = TD₅₀/TI = 75/5 = 15 mg.

book_ref.quote: A low TI means the drug is more dangerous and requires careful monitoring to avoid toxicity.

blocks.prompt:
11 Compare drugs with high TI and low TI, giving two examples of each.
(Ziyada TI aur kam TI wale drugs ka muqabla karein, har aik ki do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀ safety ki pemaish hai:

book_ref.quote: Drugs like Penicillin or Paracetamol have high TI.

rows: Effective aur toxic dose mein bara farq
Effective dose toxic dose ke qareeb
Mehfooz; ghalti se double dose jaan ke liye khatra nahi
Khatarnak; ghalat dose jaan le sakti hai
Regular nigrani ki zaroorat nahi
Regular blood tests (TDM) zaroori
Penicillin, paracetamol
Warfarin (blood thinner), digoxin (dil ki dawa)

blocks.prompt:
12 Why was digoxin a frequent cause of accidental hospital deaths before blood-level monitoring?
(Blood-level monitoring se pehle digoxin hospital mein hadsati amwaat ki aam wajah kyun tha?)
blocks.explanation: Digoxin ka TI itna kam hai ke aam khane ya doosri dawaon ka chhota sa asar bhi mareez ko jaan-lewa toxic zone mein le jata tha. Is ki toxicity ventricular fibrillation (dil ki jaan-lewa dharkan) aur peeli nazar (xanthopsia) paida karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Before modern blood-level monitoring, Digoxin was a frequent cause

blocks.prompt:
13 How is the acidity of the stomach maintained, and why is it important?
(Maiday ki tezabiyat kaise qaim rehti hai aur yeh kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Parietal cells H⁺ ions maiday mein pump karte hain jis se pH kam (1.5–3.5) rehti hai. Yeh tezabiyat khana hazam karne aur bacteria maarne ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: This acidity is regulated by parietal cells, which actively pump hydrogen ions

blocks.prompt:
14 The stomach has a very low pH. How does it protect itself from its own acid?
(Maiday ki pH bohat kam hai. Yeh apne hi tezaab se apne aap ko kaise bachata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maida mucus (balgham jaisi teh) aur bicarbonate ions ki moti teh se bachta hai jo cell ki satah par tezaab ko neutral kar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: which neutralize acid at the cell surface

blocks.prompt:
15 Why are some medicines given in a protective coating?
(Kuch dawaon par hifazati coating kyun chadhayi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maiday ki kam pH kuch drugs ko kimiyaai taur par badal deti hai aur woh jazb hone se pehle toot jate hain. Coating sirf kam tezabi small intestine mein hal hoti hai, is liye drug bach jata hai.

book_ref.quote: only dissolves in the less acidic small intestine

blocks.prompt:
16 What is meant by the mechanism of action of a drug? Which enzyme does aspirin block?
(Drug ke mechanism of action se kya muraad hai? Aspirin kaun sa enzyme rokti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mechanism of action yeh hai ke drug cell ki satah par kaise kaam kar ke ilaaji asar deta hai. Aspirin COX enzyme ko rokti hai.

book_ref.quote: The mechanism of action is how a drug works at a cellular level to produce medical effects.

blocks.prompt:
17 Name four respiratory infections and two skin infections treated by penicillin.
(Penicillin se ilaaj hone wale chaar saans ke aur do jild ke infections ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Saans ke infections: strep throat, pneumonia, scarlet fever, sinusitis. Jild aur naram tissue ke: cellulitis aur erysipelas.

book_ref.quote: such as respiratory infections like, strep throat, pneumonia, scarlet fever and sinusitis

blocks.prompt:
18 Name the two core rings in penicillin and give the size of each.
(Penicillin ki do bunyaadi rings ke naam aur har aik ka size likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin mein chaar-rukni beta-lactam ring aur paanch-rukni thiazolidine ring hai; dono par side chains hain. Beta-lactam ring antibiotic activity ke liye aham hai.

book_ref.quote: Both the rings have certain side chains attached to them.

blocks.prompt:
19 What are beta-lactamases? Why is the beta-lactam ring important for them?
(Beta-lactamases kya hain? Beta-lactam ring un ke liye kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Beta-lactamases bacteria ke enzymes hain jo penicillin ko be-asar karte hain. Yeh beta-lactam ring par hi hamla karte hain, yani jo ring penicillin ko asar deti hai wahi bacteria ka nishana hai.

book_ref.quote: it is the site where bacterial enzymes called beta-lactamases can attack and deactivate penicillin

blocks.prompt:
20 Give reason: penicillin kills bacteria but does not harm human cells.
(Wajah batayein: penicillin bacteria ko maarti hai magar insani cells ko nuqsan nahi deti.)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin bacteria ki cell wall mazboot karne wale enzyme ko be-asar kar deti hai; bacteria baghair wall ke barh kar phat jate hain. Insani cells ki cell wall hoti hi nahi, is liye un par asar nahi.

book_ref.quote: Since human cells don't have cell walls

blocks.prompt:
21 Briefly describe how penicillin was discovered.
(Penicillin ki daryaft mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: 1928 mein Alexander Fleming ne dekha ke aik petri dish par ugi phaphoondi (mold) ne aas paas ke bacteria maar diye. Yeh mold Penicillium tha jis ke maadde ne bacteria ki growth roki; is se pehli antibiotic bani.

book_ref.quote: noticed that mold growing on a contaminated petri dish had killed surrounding bacteria

blocks.prompt:
22 What are opiates? Name two legal opiates and one illegal opiate drug.
(Opiates kya hain? Do legal aur aik illegal opiate drug ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Opiates afeem ke poday se aane wale drugs hain; dard ke liye taqatwar magar nasha-awar. Legal: morphine, codeine (oxycodone, hydrocodone bhi). Illegal: heroin.

book_ref.quote: They are powerful pain relievers but also cause addiction.

blocks.prompt:
23 What are endorphins? How do opiates 'hijack' this natural system?
(Endorphins kya hain? Opiates is qudrati nizam ko kaise 'hijack' karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Endorphins hamare dimagh ke apne painkillers hain jo CNS ke opioid receptors se judte hain. Opiates unhi receptors se jud jate hain, is liye dard kam karte hain magar nasha bhi lagate hain.

book_ref.quote: Opiates “hijack” this natural system

blocks.prompt:
24 Name the three types of opioid receptors and state the role of each.
(Opioid receptors ki teen qismon ke naam aur har aik ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Teen opioid receptors:

book_ref.quote: Mu (μ) receptors are located in the brain and spinal cord.

rows: Mu (μ), dimagh aur spinal cord mein
Aksar opioids (morphine) ka asal nishana; dard kam, magar saans dheemi aur shadeed euphoria bhi
Kappa (κ)
Spinal analgesia aur sedation (ghanoodgi); euphoria kam
Delta (δ)
Jazbati radd-e-amal aur mood control

blocks.prompt:
25 What happens to the ion channels of a neuron when an opiate binds to its receptor?
(Jab opiate receptor se judta hai to neuron ke ion channels ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Opiate calcium channels band aur potassium channel khol deta hai. Is se neuron hyperpolarize ho jata hai aur dard ka signal bhejna bohat mushkil ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This hyperpolarizes the neuron

blocks.prompt:
26 Why do opiates give a feeling of well-being and become addictive?
(Opiates sukoon ka ehsaas kyun dete hain aur nasha kyun bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Opiates dimagh ke reward center mein dopamine ka ziyada ikhraaj karwate hain jo sukoon aur khushi deta hai; isi wajah se yeh nasha-awar hain.

book_ref.quote: It has been experimentally found that opiates trigger a neurochemical reaction

blocks.prompt:
27 Write three medical uses of opioids.
(Opioids ke teen ilaaji istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Achanak, thori der ke dard aur cancer ke shadeed dard mein aaraam. (2) Codeine khansi ke sharbat mein khansi ka reflex dabati hai. (3) Nizam-e-hazma ke receptors se jud kar hazma dheema aur dast mein aaraam.

book_ref.quote: Opioids are used to relief acute pain like sudden and short-term pain.

blocks.prompt:
28 Heroin was once sold as a medicine. Why did it lead to a global addiction epidemic?
(Heroin kabhi dawa ke taur par bikti thi. Is se dunya bhar mein nashe ki waba kyun phaili?)
blocks.explanation: Heroin (diacetylmorphine) Bayer 'non-addictive' dawa ke taur par bechta tha. Is ki taqat morphine se taqreeban paanch guna hai aur yeh blood-brain barrier jaldi paar karti hai, is 'rush' se nasha phaila.

book_ref.quote: Because its potency is roughly five times that of morphine

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between bacteria and viruses with respect to their treatment.
(Ilaaj ke lihaz se bacteria aur viruses mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Viral aur bacterial ilaaj bunyaadi taur par mukhtalif hai:

book_ref.quote: Unlike bacteria, which are living organisms on their own, viruses are not truly alive.

rows: Azad jandar, khud zinda
Parasites (tufaili), haqeeqat mein zinda nahi
Cell wall hoti hai jis par penicillin hamla kar sakti hai
Hamare cells ke andar reh kar hamari DNA/RNA machinery se nuqool banate hain
Insani cells ko nuqsan diye baghair maare ja sakte hain
Sehatmand cells ko nuqsan diye baghair maarna mushkil

blocks.prompt:
30 Define mutation. Why do flu vaccines need to be updated every year?
(Mutation ki tareef karein. Flu vaccine har saal kyun update hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Viruses ke genetic material ki tez tabdeeli mutation kehlati hai. Flu virus badal jata hai, is liye jo dawa ya vaccine aik saal kaam kare woh agle saal shayad na kare; is liye har saal nayi vaccine.

book_ref.quote: A drug that works against a virus one year might not work the next

blocks.prompt:
31 Why are viruses that 'sleep' in our genome difficult to treat?
(Hamare genome mein 'soye' hue viruses ka ilaaj mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch viruses hamare genome mein shamil ho kar saalon soye rehte hain. Aaj ki dawaiyan sirf active viruses maarti hain, soye hue nahi, is liye yeh bach jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Viruses also integrate into our genome and stay asleep for years.

blocks.prompt:
32 How does a protease inhibitor work as an antiviral drug? Name two infections it helps to treat.
(Protease inhibitor antiviral dawa ke taur par kaise kaam karta hai? Do infections ke naam likhein jin mein yeh madad karta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Virus apne proteins aik lambi lari (polyprotein) ki shakal mein banata hai. Protease inhibitor viral protease ko yeh lari kaat kar kaam ke proteins banane se rokta hai. Yeh HIV aur hepatitis C ke ilaaj mein madadgar hai.

book_ref.quote: The virus does make its proteins as one long strand (a polyprotein).

blocks.prompt:
33 How do antiviral medications act on the viral life cycle? What are interferons?
(Antiviral dawaiyan virus ke life cycle par kaise asar karti hain? Interferons kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Antivirals virus ke life cycle ke khaas marahil ko nishana banate hain: kuch virus ko cell mein dakhil hone se rokte hain, kuch genetic material ki nakal banne se. Interferons proteins hain jo immune system ko viruses se larne ke liye taqatwar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Some antiviral drugs enhance the immune response to viral infections.

blocks.prompt:
34 What are fertilizers? Write their benefits.
(Fertilizers kya hain? In ke fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fertilizers aise chemicals hain jo poudon ko zaroori ghiza de kar growth aur paidawar barhate hain. Yeh thaki hui mitti ko dobara bharte aur behtar khoraak paida karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Fertilizers are the mineral rich superfood given to the soil which improves its fertility.

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between macronutrients and micronutrients of plants, with examples.
(Poudon ke macronutrients aur micronutrients mein misaalon ke saath farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Poudon ko satrah (17) zaroori elements chahiye:

book_ref.quote: The micronutrients include boron, iron, copper, chlorine, manganese, molybdenum and zinc.

rows: Ziyada miqdaar mein chahiye
Thori miqdaar mein chahiye
Nau elements
Aath elements
C, H, O, N, P, S, K, Ca, Mg
B, Fe, Cu, Cl, Mn, Mo, Ni, Zn
N, P, K primary macronutrients hain
Nickel book ki list mein reh gaya tha

blocks.prompt:
36 What are primary macronutrients? What does the N-P-K ratio on a fertilizer bag show?
(Primary macronutrients kya hain? Khaad ki bori par N-P-K ratio kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nau macronutrients mein se nitrogen, phosphorus aur potassium itni ziyada miqdaar mein chahiye ke unhein primary macronutrients kehte hain. N-P-K ratio khaad mein in teen ki concentration batata hai.

book_ref.quote: which represent the concentration of these three elements

blocks.prompt:
37 Why is nitrogen called the most limiting factor in crop production?
(Nitrogen ko faslon ki paidawar ka sab se bara limiting factor kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen amino acids (jo proteins banate hain) aur chlorophyll (photosynthesis ka rang) ka bunyaadi hissa hai. Nitrogen kam ho to protein aur chlorophyll nahi bante aur growth ruk jati hai.

book_ref.quote: and chlorophyll, the pigment responsible for photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
38 State the role of phosphorus in plants and the form in which it is supplied.
(Poudon mein phosphorus ka kirdar aur woh kis shakal mein diya jata hai, likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus ATP (adenosine triphosphate) ka hissa hai jo energy jama aur kharch karta hai. Yeh aam taur par superphosphates ya ammonium phosphates ki shakal mein diya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Phosphorus is a structural component of ATP

blocks.prompt:
39 How does the role of potassium differ from that of nitrogen and phosphorus?
(Potassium ka kirdar nitrogen aur phosphorus se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen aur phosphorus poude ki banawat (proteins, chlorophyll, ATP) ka hissa bante hain. Potassium nahi banta; yeh osmoregulator hai aur saath se ziyada enzymes active karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Unlike nitrogen and phosphorus, potassium does not become part of the plant

blocks.prompt:
40 Write two harmful effects of excessive or long-term use of fertilizers.
(Khaad ke ziyada ya lambe istemal ke do nuqsanat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Ziyada khaad daryaon aur jheelon mein ja kar algae ko had se ziyada barhati hai jo aabi zindagi ke liye nuqsan-deh hai. (2) Lamba istemal mitti ki pH badalta aur mufeed microorganisms maarta hai.

book_ref.quote: if too much is used, the excess can wash away into rivers and lakes

blocks.prompt:
41 Why do farmers rotate crops?
(Kisan faslein kyun badalte hain (crop rotation)?)
blocks.explanation: Har saal aik hi fasal mitti se wahi ghiza khatam karti hai. Fasal badalne se ghiza wapas aati hai aur synthetic khaad ki zaroorat kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Growing the same crop every year depletes the same nutrients.

blocks.prompt:
42 Define pesticides. How are they classified?
(Pesticides ki tareef karein. Inhein kaise baanta jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pesticides woh chemicals hain jo keeron, jangli ghaas ya phaphoondi ko maarte ya control karte hain. Nishane ke lihaz se teen qismein: insecticides, herbicides aur fungicides.

book_ref.quote: Pesticides are chemicals used to kill or control pests like insects, weeds, or fungi.

blocks.prompt:
43 How do modern insecticides kill insects? Which insecticides are linked with harm to honeybees?
(Jadeed insecticides keeron ko kaise maarte hain? Kaun se insecticides shehad ki makhiyon ke nuqsan se jure hain?)
blocks.explanation: Organophosphates aur neonicotinoids neurotoxins hain jo keeron ka nizam-e-asaab tabah kar ke mafloj kar ke maarte hain. Neonicotinoids shehad ki makhiyon ke Colony Collapse Disorder se jure hain.

book_ref.quote: which damage the nervous system of insects leading to paralysis and death

blocks.prompt:
44 Describe two ways in which herbicides kill weeds.
(Herbicides jangli ghaas ko maarne ke do tareeqay bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Kuch enzyme ko rok kar zaroori amino acids banne nahi dete. (2) Kuch electron transport bigaar kar photosynthesis rok dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Some herbicides cause enzyme inhibition, and do not allow synthesis of essential amino acids.

blocks.prompt:
45 How do fungicides kill fungi? Is zinc phosphide a fungicide?
(Fungicides phaphoondi ko kaise maarte hain? Kya zinc phosphide fungicide hai?)
blocks.explanation: Triazoles jaise fungicides fungal cell membrane mein ergosterol banna rokte hain; mazboot membrane ke baghair cell leak ho kar mar jata hai. Zinc phosphide fungicide nahi, balke rodenticide (choohe maar zehar) hai.

book_ref.quote: and without a stable membrane, the fungal cell leaks and dies

blocks.prompt:
46 Write three harmful effects of pesticides on health and the environment.
(Pesticides ke sehat aur mahol par teen nuqsanat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Yeh cancer-aawar aur asaab ke liye zehreele ho sakte hain. (2) Kheton ka behta paani aabi zaraye aur aabi jandaron ko nuqsan deta hai. (3) Mufeed keere, parinde aur shehad ki makhiyan bhi mutasir hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Beneficial insects, birds and aquatic organism can also be affected by pesticides.

blocks.prompt:
47 Define acid rain. How does it differ from normal rain in pH?
(Acid rain ki tareef karein. pH mein yeh aam barish se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain nitric aur sulphuric acid ka fizaai mixture hai jo industrial aaloodgi se banta hai. Aam barish ki pH carbonic acid ki wajah se 5.6 ya oopar hoti hai; 5.6 se kam pH wali barish acid rain hai.

book_ref.quote: Normal rain water has pH up to or above 5.6, due to carbonic acid.

blocks.prompt:
48 Write the equations for the formation of sulphuric acid and nitric acid in acid rain.
(Acid rain mein sulphuric acid aur nitric acid banne ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
2SO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 2H₂SO₄ (sulphuric acid ki tayyari)
4NO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 4HNO₃ (nitric acid ki tayyari)

book_ref.quote: react with water to form sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) and nitric acid (HNO₃)

blocks.prompt:
49 How does acid rain leach potassium from soil? Write the equation.
(Acid rain mitti se potassium kaise baha deti hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain ke H⁺ ions mitti par juray K⁺ ko hata dete hain; K⁺ beh jata hai aur poudon ko nahi milta: K⁺–Soil + H⁺ → H⁺–Soil + K⁺. Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ bhi isi tarah behte hain.

book_ref.quote: it causes a chemical reaction that leaches out essential nutrients

blocks.prompt:
50 Why is the release of aluminium ions by acid rain harmful to crops?
(Acid rain se aluminium ions ka nikalna faslon ke liye nuqsan-deh kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain zehreele Al³⁺ ki hal-pazeeri barha deti hai (3H⁺ aik Al³⁺ ko chhurate hain). Jarein ise jazb kar ke kharab hoti hain, ghiza kam jazb hoti hai, growth aur paidawar ghatti hai.

book_ref.quote: increase the solubility of toxic metals, like aluminium

blocks.prompt:
51 Give reason: fish die in acidic lakes.
(Wajah batayein: tezabi jheelon mein machhliyan mar jati hain.)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain mitti se Al³⁺ nikalti hai. Al³⁺ machhli ke galphare band kar deta hai, oxygen kam jazb hoti hai aur machhli ka dam ghut jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Why fish die in acidic lakes?

blocks.prompt:
52 Using the equation for nitric acid formation, calculate the moles of O₂ needed and of HNO₃ formed from 6 mol of NO₂.
(Nitric acid ki equation se 6 mol NO₂ ke liye darkaar O₂ aur banne wale HNO₃ ke mol nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 4NO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 4HNO₃. O₂ = 6 × 1/4 = 1.5 mol. HNO₃ = 6 × 4/4 = 6 mol.

book_ref.quote: These gases, often from industrial pollution

blocks.prompt:
53 Write two direct and indirect effects of acid rain on crops.
(Acid rain ke faslon par do seedhe aur bilwasta asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Seedha: pattiyon ko nuqsan aur khushki, poday beemari ka shikar. Bilwasta: nitrogen fixation aur ghiza kam kar ke soyabean aur gandum ki paidawar ghatati hai, mitti ke microbes aur nutrient cycles bigaarti hai.

book_ref.quote: Direct acid rain can damage the leaves, dehydrate them

blocks.text: 32.8 Effect of Climate Change on Crops

blocks.prompt:
54 How do high and low temperatures affect crops?
(Ziyada aur kam darja-e-hararat faslon par kaise asar karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ziyada garmi metabolism tez karti hai magar had se ziyada garmi heat stress aur paani ki kami se photosynthesis kamzor kar ke paidawar ghatati hai. Sardi kuch faslon ko nuqsan deti aur chhote poudon ke liye jaan-lewa hai.

book_ref.quote: Higher temperatures can speed up a plant

blocks.prompt:
55 How do changes in rainfall patterns harm agriculture?
(Barish ke andaz badalne se zaraat ko kaise nuqsan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Barish ka andaz badalne se kahin khushk-saali aur kahin selaab aata hai, dono se fasal tabah hoti hai. Achanak barish aur cloud burst mitti ka kataao kar ke zarkhez oopri mitti baha le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: changes in rainfall patterns can lead to drought in some areas and floods in others

blocks.prompt:
56 How do hailstorms and heat waves damage crops?
(Olay aur heat waves faslon ko kaise nuqsan dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Olay pattiyon, phal aur tanon ko zakhmi kar ke photosynthesis kamzor karte hain; shadeed olay poori fasal tabah kar sakte hain. Heat waves aur ziyada UV-index garmi ka dabao, paani ka tez nuqsan aur pattiyon ka jalna karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Severe hailing can cause total loss of yield by crop destruction.

blocks.prompt:
57 How are scientists helping crops adapt to climate change? Give examples.
(Scientists faslon ko mausami tabdeeli ke mutabiq kaise bana rahe hain? Misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh mukhtalif mausam bardasht karne wali qismein bana rahe hain, maslan khushk-saali bardasht makai aur garmi bardasht gandum, aur selaab-proof 'Sub1 rice' jo do hafte paani mein zinda rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: scientists are developing new crop varieties that are more resilient

blocks.prompt:
58 What is a genetically modified (GM) crop? Write two of its benefits.
(Genetically modified (GM) fasal kya hai? Is ke do fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: GM fasal woh hai jis ka DNA genes jor kar, nikal kar ya badal kar pasandeeda khoobiyon ke liye tabdeel kiya gaya ho. Fawaid: keeron aur beemariyon se behtar bachao aur ziyada ghizaiyat, paidawar ziyada aur pesticide kam.

book_ref.quote: This is used to create genetically modified (GM) crops with desired traits.

blocks.prompt:
59 Give one example each of a GM crop that reduces pesticide use and one that improves nutrition.
(Aik GM fasal ki misaal dein jo pesticide kam kare aur aik jo ghizaiyat behtar kare.)
blocks.explanation: BT-Cotton apna pesticide khud banati hai, chemical spray kam lagta hai. Golden Rice mein beta-carotene dala gaya hai ta ke taraqqi-pazeer mulkon mein andha-pan na ho.

book_ref.quote: Golden Rice is engineered with beta-carotene

blocks.prompt:
60 What are 'superweeds'? How are they formed?
('Superweeds' kya hain? Yeh kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Superweeds woh jangli ghaas hai jis mein cross-pollination ke zariye GM fasal se herbicide-resistant genes aa jate hain, aur woh herbicide se nahi marti.

book_ref.quote: making them impossible to kill

blocks.prompt:
61 State the roles of air and water as raw materials for the chemical industry.
(Chemical industry ke khaam maal ke taur par hawa aur paani ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hawa fertilizers ke liye nitrogen aur steel ke liye oxygen deti hai. Paani solvent (hal karne wala), thanda karne wala aur hydrogen ka zariya hai.

book_ref.quote: Water is used as a solvent, a cooling agent, and a source of hydrogen.

blocks.prompt:
62 Why is Khewra rock salt important for Pakistan's chemical industry?
(Khewra ka rock salt Pakistan ki chemical industry ke liye kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khewra dunya ke sab se bare rock salt zakheeron mein se hai. Yeh NaCl deta hai jis se soda ash (Na₂CO₃), caustic soda (NaOH) aur chlorine bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Rock Salt (Khewra Mines): Khewra mines are one of the world

blocks.prompt:
63 Why are fertilizers more affordable for farmers in Pakistan?
(Pakistan mein kisanon ke liye khaad sasti kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pakistan mein natural gas bohat hai jo urea (NH₂CONH₂) ka asal khaam maal hai. Khaam maal mulk mein milta hai, is liye laagat kam aur khaad sasti hai.

book_ref.quote: Because raw material is locally available, production costs are lower

blocks.prompt:
64 Write the uses of limestone, gypsum and chromite found in Pakistan.
(Pakistan mein milne wale limestone, gypsum aur chromite ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Limestone (Salt Range, Sindh): cement ke liye CaCO₃. Gypsum: cement, plaster, calcium aur sulphur ka zariya, soil conditioner. Chromite (Muslim Bagh): stainless steel aur pigments (rang).

book_ref.quote: It is a source of calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) for the cement industry.

blocks.prompt:
65 Name three chemicals used by the textile industry and the purpose of each.
(Textile industry ke teen chemicals aur har aik ka maqsad likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Caustic soda cotton ki mercerizing ke liye; synthetic dyes rang aur pukhtagi (fastness) ke liye; hydrogen peroxide kapre bleach karne ke liye.

book_ref.quote: synthetic dyes to provide colour and fastness

blocks.prompt:
66 How does local urea production help Pakistan's economy?
(Mulk mein urea banana Pakistan ki maeeshat ki kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pakistan zaraati mulk hai aur us ki food security chemical industry par mabni hai. Companies natural gas se urea banati hain jis se import bill arbon dollar kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: As an agrarian economy, Pakistan

blocks.prompt:
69 Outline the contact process. Why is sulphuric acid called the 'King of Chemicals'?
(Contact process mukhtasar likhein. Sulphuric acid ko 'King of Chemicals' kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: SO₂ ko V₂O₅ ya Pt catalyst se SO₃ banaya jata hai; SO₃ se oleum aur aakhir mein khalis, gaadha H₂SO₄ banta hai. Sulphuric acid dunya mein sab se ziyada istemal hota hai, is liye 'King of Chemicals'.

book_ref.quote: This process produces highly pure and concentrated form of H₂SO₄.

blocks.prompt:
70 Briefly describe the Solvay process and name its by-product.
(Solvay process mukhtasar bayan karein aur us ka by-product batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Brine mein ammonia mila kar CO₂ guzari jati hai, NaHCO₃ ka precipitate banta hai; garam karne se Na₂CO₃ milta hai. CaCO₃ ke tootne se bane lime se ammonia wapas li jati hai. By-product: CaCl₂.

book_ref.quote: Ammonia is added to brine, and carbon dioxide is passed through it

blocks.prompt:
71 Why is the chlor-alkali process important? Which technology do modern plants use?
(Chlor-alkali process kyun aham hai? Jadeed plants kaun si technology istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Brine ki electrolysis se Cl₂, NaOH aur H₂ bante hain jo plastics, detergents aur paani saaf karne ki cheezon ke liye zaroori hain. Jadeed plants membrane cell technology istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: It is crucial for manufacturing plastics, detergents, and water treatment products

blocks.prompt:
72 How is the Haber-Bosch process linked with urea production in Pakistan?
(Haber-Bosch process Pakistan mein urea banane se kaise juda hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haber process mein N₂ aur H₂ se iron catalyst par ammonia banti hai. Engro Fertilizers aur FFC natural gas se ammonia bana kar use urea mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Large-scale plants like Engro Fertilizers and FFC

blocks.prompt:
73 Name the three types of chemicals used by the cosmetics industry and the role of each.
(Cosmetics industry ke teen qism ke chemicals aur un ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Surfactants sabun ke liye; emulsifiers cream ko hamwaar rakhne ke liye; preservatives bacteria ki growth rokne ke liye. Chemistry products ko jild ke liye pH-balanced bhi banati hai.

book_ref.quote: This industry uses surfactants (for soaps)

blocks.prompt:
74 How is cement manufactured? Why does freshly mixed cement become warm?
(Cement kaise banta hai? Taaza mila cement garam kyun ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Limestone aur clay ka mixture rotary kiln mein 1500 °C tak garam kar ke paidawar ko gypsum ke saath peesa jata hai. Paani ke saath cement exothermic hydration reaction karta hai jo garmi chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: Cement industry uses limestone and clay to make a key building material.

blocks.prompt:
75 Write four uses of chemistry in the food industry.
(Food industry mein chemistry ke chaar istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Sodium benzoate preservative. (2) Tel ki hydrogenation se margarine. (3) Baking mein sodium bicarbonate (baking soda). (4) Fortification: namak mein iodine ya tel mein vitamin A.

book_ref.quote: Leavening agents like sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) is used in baking.

blocks.prompt:
76 What is PPE? Why should workers in chemical industries use it?
(PPE kya hai? Chemical industry ke workers ko yeh kyun pehnna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: PPE zaati hifazati saaman hai: gloves, goggles, helmet, lab coat aur hifazati joote. Yeh chemicals, garmi aur nuqsan-deh fumes se chot se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: to avoid injuries from chemicals, heat, or harmful fumes

blocks.prompt:
77 How should hazardous chemicals be stored in an industry?
(Industry mein khatarnak chemicals kaise rakhne chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Inhein un ki khasoosiyat ke mutabiq label laga kar sambhal kar rakha jaye. Aag pakarne wale, zehreele ya corrosive maadde munasib dabbon mein alag jagah rakhe jayen ta ke leak, girna ya khatarnak reaction na ho.

book_ref.quote: Chemicals must be properly labeled, handled, and stored according to their properties.

blocks.prompt:
78 Why are safety training and regular inspection necessary in chemical facilities?
(Chemical facilities mein safety training aur regular muainah kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Training workers ko khatarnak maadde aur mashinein mehfooz tareeqay se chalana sikhati hai. Machines, pipelines aur tanks ka regular muainah kharabi jaldi pakar kar hadsaat kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Workers must receive proper safety training on handling hazardous materials
